t:
My, my. Look what has happened. You have sent Boris in a spiraling rage by delivering him the wrong tools that no Gipat merchant can possibly use. He has been without work for quite some time. What's worse now is that there are no clients in his shop!
What's that you say? His favorite drill and hand blade had been taken from the commander and his wife?
Weird. This means that someone stole Boris' real instruments and slipped false ones behind those bandits' backs!
Do you see now? This frustrating occurrence is one of the many challenges that will try to bump you off your Chosen Path. Nevertheless, you must push on and do your best to solve this mystery, right? I'll assist you.
Accept this magic metal detector. It will steer you in the right direction to find Boris' real toolbox. My dragon sense tingles. Something tells me the thieves are somewhere around this village. Run your scanner up and down those Gibberlings. They always seem to be up to no good.
Hurry up and find these instruments as soon as possible. And I'll calm down the craftsman.
Time us running out. Wherever those tools are needs to be found before they end up in the wrong hands again!
It looks like you put that magical scanner to good use. See, I told you it was those tricksters. Great detective work! At least you put one raging ghost to rest...
Find the mysterious Orc that the Scratchy Family mentioned.

What do you want? We're not like other idiots dragging around the foothills repeating heroic deeds of Ath-Zak. We don't want to do it! If he were at least a Gibberling, we would think it over.
Hey, since you were so lucky at finding Boris' tools, maybe you can solve a mystery for us too. Something peculiar caught our attention earlier. We saw an Orc around here. He wasn't ghostly, but in full flesh and blood! At first we thought is was an Imperial citizen, but then we looked closer. Something was wrong. Judging from its savage-like armor, it seems he wasn't with the Imperial army.
Who was he then? Damned if we know! We decided to keep our distance. If you want to have a look, you may go and see. He's not far from off from the trail ahead.
Hopefully you can find that Orc, so you don't think we're crazy. Tricksters we are, but crazy... No way!
So, it's true that there are not only ghostly beings, but real native creatures on Gipat. They sure don't like our presence here though.
Find Semer Akhenaten, leader of the rebels in Gipatia, and tell him the password.

Come closer, we will tell you.
There are many others who don't want to dance to the Dragons' tune of some promise of a "Revelation". We are not puppets just to be manipulated! We refuse to take part in this damned play! We are free citizens of the League and... the Empire! Together we have formed an underground organization.
Don't you want to find out everything? Who are those ghosts and living orcs? This is very suspicious.
Still not a believer of our conspiracy theory? Fine. Seek out our leader, Semer Akhenaten, in the village and find out the truth from him! Tell him: "Blunt drill. Sharp hand blade". It is a secret password.

"Blunt drill. Sharp hand blade"? Well, well, what do you know about it?.
Ok, I'll brief you if you swear to keep the secret, and that you are also irritated by all this and... that you believe in love.
Swear before me!

While we are waiting news from Zayan, let's make another ancient find!
We need to investigate origins of ghosts. In particular, sparks of the fallen.
I have always been a follower of Zosim's theory: "Spark, the base component that gives life to us and is an essence of Tensess' Gift, is not connected to the, so-called, ghosts, who are really magical creatures not under the church's control."
With that said, the circle of investigation is easier to understand now. I hope we will find truth soon. Here is a June gadget. It catches and analyzes magical emanations. Use it on ghost wolfs, boars, and toads. We won't bother the villagers though. And we also don't know how the dragons will treat our experiment, so let's keep this between us. I anxiously await your return!

I'm a Historian, not a priest. And it's good that those ghosts are not just wandering souls.
Sparks of rational creatures are understudied as you can never be sure if the picture of world creation is right or not.
Each time that I die, I'm afraid to vanish somewhere on the road to Purgatory. Who knows what is waiting there? Magic is more easy and understandable.

Ah, give it here. That magic detector gives the results we need.
Now... Oh, look at this!
Try to get in touch with a ghost in the Bandit's Camp with the Coba Stone.

Don't be scared. It's ok.
But... It's so extraordinary. Magic of Light! These ghostly spirits were created by magic of Light, and that same holy magic are powers used by the Church! Don't tell anybody our shocking discovery! We need not panic. I know what to do.
I have an artifact from Coba Plateau. It was created by mages with the help of those artifacts of darkness called shards of Light. By using it we can fuse it with the magic of Light and see what happens.
I would like to use the shard on a rational being and have an opportunity to contact him later. But we can't do it within the village. As the legend goes, bandits inhabit a camp north of the Windswept Foothills, so that would be the right place to run our test. Can you approach one of those ghostly bandits and use stone on them? Try to do it. It is very important!
Share the results of the experiment to the Historian Delmon de Blizare in the Village.

Set me free! Set my soul free! I beg you, set me free!
I beg you...

I don't believe it! So the magic of Light weakened and from its ghostly cocoon appeared a soul?
And this soul was calling for help! What is going on with Gipat! How it is possible that such great, holy magic of Light torments and enslaves souls?
I'm completely puzzled.
Semer Akhenaten asks to find out what the Orcs in Gipat know about eternal love.

I've come here in search of eternal love as this is the very place where Ath-Zak made his heroic deed for the sake of love.
And what do I see? Blasphemy! Fake Chosen Ones trying to make a farce out of the June's heroic deed!
Surprised that the Arisen are so curious and fond of eternal love? Believe me, only we a better understanding than anyone else. The lives of Kanians and Xadaganians are so short that they often leave their love and find another one. Elves wallow in narcissism and rush to judge beauty from what's on the outside. Gibberlings love everyone and everything, but it is fake to be so happy all the time.
I created this underground group to protect the memory of unappreciated true love. Will you help us? Maybe these strange Orcs know something that may help us to put an end to this drama! Their camp is to the southeast. Seek out the wise shaman. That's where we'll get our questions answered.

Keep your voice down. There are a lot of obedient asses who are loyal to the idea of the Performance.
And asses are known to have long ears.

"Lords" are Gods who can read minds? Maybe they are just charlatans who managed to impress naive savages with their flashy tricks?
But their protective ruins truly have enormous power. It looks like we will never break through to the villains. A great feat has turned into a farce...
Oh, cursed and blessed Tep, why did you let me live to such a dark day?
Following Victor Terdolobin's order, talk to the Spirit of Fate in Village about alliance between the Empire and Masters of Orcs.

Look, I decided our next course of action.
Orcs mentioned something about their Lords being eager to restore Gipat? Obviously, the Performance is part of this rehabilitation program. It means that the dragon spirits also obey the same masters that Orcs do.
Here's what needs to be done. Go to the little dragon and tell him that you need to talk to Lords to sign a peace treaty. Keep your shoulder straight, chest forward, and speak in an upfront tone. Maybe then the little dragon will stop talking about some Performance and start a normal political dialogue.

Foolish, Chosen Ones. You are just like children playing in the sand who do not see the storm that will engulf us all. I will answer your fatuous question - you will meet those whom Orcs call Masters. But in due time.
You'll find that you'll be wasting their time just like you are wasting mine with your suggestions for a useless union. The threat of storm unites us much more effectively than any signed documents. You will understand this one day.
For our purposes, there is only one way out of this mess - the Chosen Path. Take it to the end. And if you are still interested in such nonsense, you can talk to them about the alliance.
On behalf of Laura de Grandeur, ask Dragon Guide, Spirit of Fate, for a meeting with Gipat Masters.

Prayers helped me to return self-control. I think we should find a way to talk to those masters. If they are trying to repair Gipat, they started this weird Performance, but maybe it's for some high purpose that we cannot see now.
We must get them to unite as one. Together, we can end the war, defeat the Empire, and liberate oppressed citizens. Not to mention we will offer them moral, free thoughts, and Tensess' blessing.
Go to the Spirit of Fate and try to organize a meeting with masters.

Foolish, Chosen Ones. You are just like children playing in the sand who do not see the storm that will engulf us all. I will answer your fatuous question - you will meet those whom Orcs call Masters. But in due time.
You'll find that you'll be wasting their time just like you are wasting mine with your suggestions for a useless union. The threat of storm unites us much more effectively than any signed documents. You will understand this one day.
For our purposes, there is only one way out of this mess - the Chosen Path. Take it to the end. And if you are still interested in such nonsense, you can talk to them about the alliance.

Have you ever met the local Orcs? They're bastards, they are! We try to abide by the truce, but they always treat us like crap!
They give us a giant scolding and they have taken our most valuable things! What overgrown bullies!
We must teach them a lesson. Let them vent their anger on the goblins! Take away their knives and their rings. Let's steal from those thieves.
You shouldn't offend Gibberlings! Those wild Orcs might be able to do that on another allod, but they'll get shot here in Gipat for talking smack!

Many thanks!
It's so unpleasant to feel anxiety! We even had stomach aches. Though now, since we have been avenged, we feel much better!
Meet Nim the Avenger at the Wild Orcs' Camp on Gipat

To be honest, I don't know how to get to their camp. They say that lightning strikes those who dare to come close. But I know that local orcs enslaved some goblins... Distressed and starving, poor creatures are forced to do the hard work. Imperial orcs do not act like this!
I hope the servants will comply easier than their masters. They may help you to approach the shaman. Speak with Nim the Avenger, one of the goblins discontent with the slavery. He tried to find allies among the Chosen Ones in order to liberate the goblins. You can meet him by the bridge, near the Orc's camp.
Hey, you must be the Chosen One! Hold on.
Find out more information on the fate of the village ghosts from the shaman in the Wild Orcs' Camp and report back to Evgenya Radova.

You know, when I first received the letter of Chosen One with the mysterious stone inside, I immediately tossed it in my spam mail box thinking it was some advertisement for naughty Elven graphics. Thank the Light that I opened the letter. What if I haven't come here at all...
Why did I ask you to come? Oh yeah! I believe the village spirits are not just simple ghosts. Their sparks and language appear to remain here in captivity of transparent bodies with no way to escape.
We must find a way to help them! If Orcs have been living here for so long, they should know more what happened with Gipatia. Why don't you ask their wise shaman?

Are the village wanderers doomed forever to repeat their actions?
Perhaps they have already abandoned all hope.

You're telling me that it was the Orcs who killed everyone in the Village? Why did the Great Mage Tka-Rik not help? Is it possible that the Great Mages are too busy with global issues that they fail to see the problems of mere mortals...
Anyway, if Orcs' "Lords" are so powerful, it is likely them who started the Performance and cursed the Gipatians into this state of unrest. Unfortunately, due to the storm traps that guard the Cursed Path, we won't be able to even get close enough to persuade them to release the ghosts' sparks. This is sad...
Perhaps there is another way to help them.
On the order of Viktor Tverdolobin, establish an alliance between the Orcs of Gipat and the Empire.

I have just received word that there is a camp of normal, breathing Orcs on Gipat. Long story short, a drunken Elf blurted that he accidentally stumbled upon them.
I order you to seek our their camp right away and invite them to join our Imperial forces. Tell them something uplifting about the Empire. I don't know, "Keeping territorial integrity and cultural heritage". I'll leave it up to you, but we just need them to be impressed our already existing army of Orcs. As for compulsory military service, we will tell them about it later.
You need to find the right approach - promise to give them food, gold, fine Xadaganian women... And don't forget to mention about Goblinball. They'll sure get a kick out of that!

Did the Orcs agree to join our powerful faction?
Their tribe is the size of a drop in a large sea of water, but just think what valuable information about Gipat they can provide!

You mean they turned their cheek to your offer? "The Empire and the League will die soon"? That's too much. Who do these savages think they are?
Though wait a bit... Now we know about their "Lords". Perhaps we don't need Orcs at all. They are just pawns...
Go to the Orcs' camp and prevent the alliance with the Empire as instructed by Laura de Grandeur of the Village.

We have new problem, a serious one. Having found out that Gipat Orcs are not ghosts, the Empire will attempt to ally with them, and we can't let it happen.
Go to Shaman of Orcs and tell him how immoral, deceitful, and greedy the Empire is. On second thought... These words may seem tempting for the wild orcs given their wild nature. It might be wiser to point out the advantages of the Imperials to turn off those wild savages.
Tell Orcs about the Empire's discipline, strict subordination, compulsory duty service, and readiness of every citizen to self-sacrifice.
Sometimes the League lacks such commitment. Oh, Eternal Light, I hope I won't fall into heresy...

I calmed down and understood that I was wrong.
We don't need Imperial totalitarian enforcement mechanisms to make people a sense of responsibility for their homeland. But still... Hurry. If we do not talk the Orcs out from allying with the Empire, the very Truce of Gipat may be in jeopardy!

"The League and the Empire will die soon"? That's what the shaman said? Oh, Tensess... Of course I'm glad there is no need to scare off their alliance, but these words...
What if it is not just foolish pagan chatter? What if these "Masters" unveiled them something that we are not able to see or understand yet? I never imagined such an end.
I'm sorry but I need time to cleanse myself from sinful thoughts, so I can plan our next course of action. Hopefully there is still time left for actions...

Hey, you, give me your hand. I'll tell you your fortune. Oh, what a big hand... Strong, calloused. A great deed is waiting for you. You will help a small but brave nation. Its name begins with "G". Not Gibberlings! Boo hoo to those furry slippers ! You're destined to help goblins!
We are in slavery. Orcs oppress us. Our spirits are weakened, but not broken. We are ready to rise our weapons against our torturers. But where can we get weapons?
I see it now. You will overpower the Orcs and give their weapons to my fellow goblins. Those Orcs will think twice before raising their whips at us again!
Hurry, we need to give weapons to our comrades while those overgrown pigs know nothing of our plan!

Hooray! Attack! Brothers, let's fight for our freedom! Let's put and end to the Goblinball! Orcslay will be Sarnaut's new sport! Watch us cut up those Orcs and carve their curvy spines into slides for our young ones!
Are you saying that I'm a coward? Then drink homebrew, shrink down to our level, hit a table with your helm, and then I will respect your glory.
Are you saying that Gibberlings are small also? They are three and they have ale. We don't have even beer, and we are strictly forbidden to team up three on one...While they are looking, that is. Orcs will forever be our sworn enemies!
Ring the gong to signal the rebellion and talk to Klo the Ferocious.

Everything is ready for revolt!
I'll distribute the weapons and you strike the alarm bell! It's right behind you, silly!
Now you will see goblins fighting for their freedom! And no lightning will shock us in the ass ever again!
Come on! For freedom! For equality!
Ahh! Revolt has failed. Our brave rebels are all dead! Lightning never misses!

Uprising failed! It's like they knew our plan and pinned us from all sides with spears. You know, I don't think you put your heart into our attempt for freedom. After all, your kind play Goblinball at the enjoyment of our misery!
See, I was a clever goblin twisting my body to evade incoming kicks to manipulate the players' games. Doing so gave me lots of laughs despite the constant bruises.
Now because of our failed rebellion, I have to give Orcs everything I have so that they don't beat us to pulps more than they already do. Go to my hiding place. It's in a fallen tree to the northeast and bring my treasures to the shaman. And keep praying that his heart softens to cut us some slack.

Stop, be quiet.
I'm a negotiator. We will have a conversation. I love beautiful words.

You are stupid thinking goblins and orcs can live in peace.
Tomorrow Klo is surely to get a good beating to make him think before attempting a riot in the future.
Our shaman is wise. He foresaw the goblins' sneaky plan and baited them in. Shaman doesn't want to infuriate the Lords by establishing a treaty among races that is not supposed to exist. Goblins serve Orcs. Orcs rule over goblins. That's how we lived and that's how we will go about our ways.
With permission from Sharha the Wily, go to the top of the pyramid under the protection of Orcish Emblem and talk to Stomper the Wily.

You want to talk to our shaman, eh? Here is the Orcish Emblem. It is a sign of peace and good will. It will also protect you from the Lords' electric surge and you'll be able to approach the shaman.
But Stomper doesn't like to talk much. He has so much work - ruling over goblins, sharing loot among tribal members, blessing our camp with his voodoo magic.
I enjoyed our chat, but I'm getting tired too fast. Leave me to go rest and go slap Klo the stupid. Ha! Have a good hunt, stranger.

Grr! How did you manage to pass past the Lords' blazing fire? Has Sharha given you that emblem there?
Well, I will answer your questions and you must go back! Quickly. Lords told me to be quiet and not bother myself with outsiders.
But if you ever return, we will throw you into the Astral!
Semer Akhenaten wants you to admit to the Spirit of Resolve that he is the one to blame for attempting to sabotage the Performance.

If I don't at least try to protect you from angering Gipat's "Lords" from that goblin stunt of yours, I will let down my values. Tell the dragon spirit that I am in charge of the underground organization.
I finally want to open my heart to you. Even when I was an ordinary human, I fell in love with a girl. Then our tribe crumbled. After many years we have risen... And my love to Nefertiti resurrected with me.
Memory is what differs us from the undead. Memories about what it is like to be alive and flourishing. Like a phoenix from its ashes, we are reborn from the memory of our love. Love doesn't depend on hormones and passionate lust. It is eternal.
I hoped to find my Nefertiti here where loving hearts of Junes have long ago united. But I failed. I prey, if you meet her somewhere along your Path, deliver my eternal love to her!

What a fool! How could Semer ever be fit as a rebel leader? His weak-minded self won't help anybody.
Lover of Zem! What other curses will you will bring upon us? World Prisoners? Orc Researchers? Goblin Poets? Elven Altruists and non-drinking Gibberlings?!
Your absurd attempts to help him disrupt the Performance has only clouded your judgment. We all knew and did not want to interfere. Sometimes the shortest way to the realize the truth is an attempt to escape from it. We let you act in opposition, but it time to stop playing. We need you... All of you to finish your Paths!
After talking to Evgenya Radova, turn into a ghost and talk to the Gipatia's dwellers about their fate.

While you were at the Orc' camp, the goblin spirit from Purgatory paid me a visit. To leave Purgatory and be amongst the living is very rare. Apparently, he heard about your heroic deeds at the Wild Orcs' Camp.
Through conversing with him, I found out that he has been helping the goblins for a long time. He taught them to read and write and told them stories of the large world outside of Gipat. Evidently, we have the wrong view of goblins...
In gratitude of assisting his goblin kind, he granted me the ability to open a passage to ghostly reality for you. Now you can tell the village people about their fate. Return when you want to go the valley of the shadows and talk to its inhabitants.
Did the village inhabitants know about their fate? We obviously were not able to change it, but we can tell them the truth. It will make their suffering easier to bare.

Thank you.
This act is worthy of a true follower of the Light. I am sure now it will be a bit easier for them.
Uncertainty is worse than death. You see now that they have accepted their fate and are preparing to live under new conditions. Even ghosts can be optimistic!

Here's the first task from Ath-Zak's doing. Kill ten goblins that infest our pasture. Repeat the feat of June and punish them for their rebellion. Let them see what it means to act against the Performance.

Only strict instructions following the Performance will set you back on your Path. Please remember that...
Letting some goblins sacrifice their lives will let us all live a little more.

Good... Now you've become closer to understanding our intentions, and the role of the Chosen One.
However, I can still sense doubts gnawing at your heart. Your soul is unsure and finds no answers. Forget your doubts and continue to follow the Path.
Kill the Phantom Thief and Ishgaz the Wily. Bring the Thief's map to the Spirit of Resolve.

Your doubts and indecision clouds your judgment. How many times do you have to repeat Ath-Zak's deeds to live up to the Chosen One title? We need to push you harder than you've been pushed before, then it will be easier for you to understand your role on Gipat.
Further prove your dedication of righteousness by taking a special map that was stolen from me from two notorious troublemakers. Keep in mind that it will be difficult for you to deal with him and his fellow outlaw. Unite with other Chosen Ones and conquer the villains. You may find yourself experiencing great power which the Path grants to those who follow it headstrong.

I'm waiting for the map...
I'm waiting to return it to a heroic rogue. He knows his role perfectly and performs everyday without doubts. Fight and accept death. You have the most important role, and despite it, you delay, have doubts, waste time...

Well, one step closer. At this rate you're proving your worth to me like when we first met.
I know it is difficult. You are agitated by questions that need to be answered. The world in your head threatens to collapse. This is one of the tests of the Chosen Path.
Overcome your fear of ignorance. The fact that you don't know everything doesn't mean that you can't do the right thing. Who knows, maybe completing these tasks again and again will help you focus on what matters most.
Following Spirit of Fate's order, pour the bottle of essence on 5 ghost wolves, boars or toads.

This next task to earn another Sign is not connected with deeds of the great June.
Ghost creatures... I'm sure you already know something about their unique nature. All around Gipatia there are those who try to understand what is beyond understanding! It's interesting to observe them.
It'll be even more interesting if I push you to find a solution to the mystery. We must support the ghostly essence. And you will help us. I'll give you the vial of ghostly essence. You need to pour the essence on ghost wolves, boars and toads. This will keep them in this world.
I wouldn't advise to fight with them after the bottle is used. You'll understand why...

I hope you won't give this bottle to somebody else.
You now know what happens to those who goes against the Path...
Good... You followed the instructions that I gave you. This will assist with the locals' research. I'll give you a Sign of Chosen.
While in a ghostly form, kill 5 ghostly creatures of each kind: wolves, boars and toads upon the request of Sergey Rybakov of the Village.

Ah, thank you for coming to our aid! Yeah, yeah, you. Other Chosen Ones are useless idlers.
Only you are the embodiment of our beloved Ath-Zak. The same nobility, selflessness, and stature. You even drop your gaze with the same modesty as he did. I know because he was like a son to me!
Please, do me a favor. We are nothing but phantoms, but we also have our needs. Please kill a handful of wolves, boars and toads for me. I know you won't even ask why we need you to do this. Just help us like how you always help everyone else.

That was quick!
Did you really mange to kill all enemies? Maybe some of them just pretended to be dead. These ghostly monsters can do such tricks.
You should hold each of them by their jaws and cut their throats. Do not forget to turn them on belly or you will be covered with blood... Oh, look at me re-living my childhood days. Old fool!

Oh, thank you, Chosen One! I was afraid that boars would be carriers of ghostly swine flu. I was told this is a bad disease!
As for wolves and toads, to be honest, I can't stand these disgusting creatures.
This spot on the sleeve, isn't it toad's poison? Under the tongue... Why are you staring at me like that? It is a delicacy, you fool.... No, far from it!
By the way, what do you think about hunting tomorrow? I will be waiting. Don't be late. And don't be afraid to get dirty with poison - I will scrape away everything.

What do you want? Looking for work? Live and let others do the same. Here is my errand for you.
Hey, don't get started with me. I know your kind very well! If I tell you what exclusive material is used for your clothes, you will become craftsmen and steal all my clients. I may be missing a brain although my intelligence still remains.
On second thought, I have no choice. All the Chosen Ones who have invaded Gipat have swept all my goods, and I have no time to make new things especially if I have to collect skins myself...
Ok, bring me ghostly skins of boars, toads and wolfs. If you don't give away my secret, I'll reward you.

Did you acquire the materials I requested?
My storage is nearly empty. It's so odd to sit without work. I've quarreled with man of the Village locals, because I have nothing to do. Please, be quick.

What took you so long? Did Sergey persuade you to work for him? He's always been a tricky character when he was alive, and now he got hooked on fog's poison, ghostly dupe. Don't turn your back to a drug addict...
Well, let's examine your loot... What the?! What are all these scraps? What did you do with them, blow them sky high? All the skins are shred, fur singed, worn from your violent overload. Have you never learned to hunt? You need to aim and shoot an arrow at one's neck for a quick fall. Were you afraid those poor toads may knock you off by accident?
Well, leave all these skin pieces here and tomorrow bring the next batch... but in better condition! Maybe I'll craft something for you that you deserve.

Hey, soldier... Ah, sorry, I thought you were a soldier.
Though all of you here are kind of military material. That makes us perfect colleagues. Something I've been wondering - Are all of Chosen Ones following Ath-Zak's Path? Repeating his deeds... Did the Dragons tell you anything about me? It was Ath-Zak himself who chose me to come with him on some of his early adventures. I bet the Dragons tell you to go do this, go kill that. Did they ever have you follow my past accomplishments? Pfff, not surprised.
Listen, as a friend, I'll tell you about one of Ath-Zak's deed: Orc killing! He loved it very much. Every morning, for exercise, he used to make cut himself a heap of Orc carcasses. You need to live up to that expectation otherwise you are a bad Chosen One.

What do you think of Ath-Zak's methods to stay in shape? Is it refreshing?
Just hit them from the back of their head like Ath-Zak did.

You're a nice lad for doing that. Unlike despicable me... It was me who set you on Orcs just for the sake of revenge. Ath-Zak had nothing to do with mindless Orc slaughter. After you told me about the Orcs' raid, I have been looking for the way to pay them back! But I could obviously do nothing - I'm too weak and cannot penetrate the living!
I'm ashamed of myself. I can't forgive myself that I tried to stab Ath-Zak. If he hadn't leave me wounded, I could have protected the Village from Orcs. Everybody would have been alive. We betrayed Ath-Zak and now we are stuck between life and death...
I want to make amends with my sins. Let's kill more Orcs tomorrow for Ath-Zak. Who knows, maybe our sins will be washed away in fury.

Hey, I have a proposition for you. It's so damned boring here. We are stuck in this nightmare running on and on about the past...
I can't leave the Village, can't drown myself with ale... I can't even strike anyone! The blow goes through. I'm like fog wearing pants.
I want to feel alive again, feel up women' buttocks, unleash my frustration on foes...
See the ghostly creatures surrounding the Village? They're like ghosts too! They are something I can pummel. Give me the inspiration I need to get my game back - take down some goblins beat their Sparks out of them! Will you do this for Ath-Zak's best friend, ha?

So, did sparks shine from my eyes? It will happen soon, I hope.
I'm trembling with anticipation. Oh, how I long for a good fight! Come on, throw them at me...

Splendid. How shrill their screams were! That's what I call resting in peace!. Nothing to do with Sergey's mean tricks - consuming poison and getting tripped out. Oh, you don't know? It's like drugs for ghosts. Digesting the poison and it makes one seem that they are alive. Ugh! I have tried it, but it's gross. Ath-Zak wouldn't approve. It's terrible what this ghostly stuff has done to us.
I'm also glad that Gorislav has come to reason. Now he feels pity about what happened to Ath-Zak. We have reconciled with him and spend the evenings together. Now we can teach sparks a lesson together. Do you want to scare off goblins again tomorrow? I will be waiting.
Upon the request of Gorislav of Gipatia, form a team and sneak into the Orcs' camp in a ghostly form. Appear right under the Shaman's nose and kill him.

I have a private requests...
Osip, my sworn brother, is showing off, expressing confidence, but I'm sure he feels nervous too when Orcs shaman is mentioned.
Aha, when you have told us about orcs, Squabbler recalled that it was Aihar who killed him. Do you think, you can kill that shaman off?
Heed caution, he is very powerful. You'd better ask friends to assist you. Go through ghostly world to avoid stroke of lightning. Then jump out to the real world right in front of him and cut the damned creep.

So, was our righteous deed successful?
I can't wait to make my friend happy, release a great weight from his soul. Ath-Zak is missing, so I would pay a price for my mistake before Osip.

Your fame goes ahead of you. In other words - spark of damned shaman. Oh, Osip taught her a lesson - tore all her beams. Dim, blinking, more dead than alive...
But I tell you it was a very important thing. Did you notice that every time Ath-Zak's name is mentioned, I start fretting? Shrug my shoulders, turn my head... I begin to feel sick. The first thing I recollect is how Ath-Zak sticks me on a blade.
But I deserve it! And what about others? To know that their murderers live in peace just near them? Now everybody has satisfied one's heart. The-ra-py, as the Arisen say, is nothing to sneeze at.
Meet Spirit of Sadness along the Cursed Path.

We did it! I could have asked you to cut fish with a blunt knife, surf the Astral on a staff, and attempt to clap with one hand. It doesn't matter now, but what we have learned is that you need to forget yourself to understand who you are.
Now you can make the next step toward your Chosen Path. The path will lead to Cursed Path through ancient June traps, from the trail that Ath-Zak traveled. Go to the next shard of my consciousness, to the Spirit of Sadness. She will lead you through the next stages of your Path.

The Path behind has been a long journey, but the Path ahead of us will be even longer. Take a breath and keep your mind open to new knowledge.
The first lesson of Sarnaut's nightmares are waiting for you.
Meet Spirit of Sadness along the Cursed Path.

We did it! I could have asked you to cut fish with a blunt knife, surf the Astral on a staff, and attempt to clap with one hand. It doesn't matter now, but what we have learned is that you need to forget yourself to understand who you are.
Now you can make the next step toward your Chosen Path. The path will lead to Cursed Path through ancient June traps, from the trail that Ath-Zak traveled. Go to the next shard of my consciousness, to the Spirit of Sadness. She will lead you through the next stages of your Path.

The Path behind has been a long journey, but the Path ahead of us will be even longer. Take a breath and keep your mind open to new knowledge.
The first lesson of Sarnaut's nightmares are waiting for you.
Find out more of the whereabouts of Gipat's Lords.

Listen to the news I just found out.
Great Elf Mage, Zayan de Desirae, reviewed the materials you collected and sent back the results of his examination. These stones are indeed ancient, but "fresh", like the flint that Boris had. Village ghosts repeat almost word by word what is written in the records of Ath-Zak's adventures. It is obvious that everything happening here and now is a reconstruction, but this is a shard of the real Gipat, and not an expensive decoration.
What remains a mystery is who are the Lords of those Orcs. Zayan is very much interested in them. Follow the trails of Gipat and it will lead you straight to them.

Mental connection is nearly established... do not fight it... free your mind...
Do you want to know who we are? Well... you will know... In due time...
Find Gipat's Lords and inform them of Osip's resurrection request.

Ah, how time drags... It seems like the throat of our sandglass is tied and grains fail to go through. Look at you, you seem just as pale as the rest of us.
Watch as the years stretch just like the time Ath-Zak ambushed the cyclops from behind with a mighty blow. But that giant stood its ground. Damned thing! I even ran out of jokes to make Ath-Zak laugh. Even my ants in the shirt joke - not even a nose twitch. He would just stand there solid like the Cyclops! Those were good times. I miss them.
Sorry, I tend to think back on my wild past so I never forget.
Hey, are you going to visit the Masters of Gipat? Give them a message for me. Tell them that I declare a boycott. Either they resurrect me, or let the winds dispel me into their nightmares!

Osip started a boycott?
Well, that was expected. I would gladly return him to his precious death, which he misses so much with great pleasure. However, he is a key figure in our Performance.
I suppose we should negotiate the terms of his resurrection.
Are you surprised this seems to be an easy victory? You know, I can foresee the ending of this story, and believe me, we have nothing to lose. But I warn you, you have to work hard to ensure the resurrection succeeds. Think carefully if you're willing to go to such extremes...
Take the form of a ghost and speak to Osip Bazhov.

I heard that you managed to find common ground with the dragons? That's excellent! Perhaps you can also agree with the Lords?
What? No, I don't need anything from them. But it seems to me that Osip Bazhov is burdened by some sadness. I can't explain it - I am unable to speak to spirits. But I can sense his grief, buried deep inside. Try to enter the ghostly plane and talk to him. He will be glad of any help.
Well, how is it going? Are you not tired of listening to ghosts moan yet?
Following the order of Victor Terdolobin, meet Gipat's Lords, and offer them Alliance with the Empire.

So, I have thought over our tactics. Obviously, we need an alliance with Lords. How to achieve such a task? They are certain that "The Empire and The League will die soon". I would like to wish this prophecy comes true by half haha...
Well, we have to coax them. So, what do Lords like? Right - the Performance. It means that you need to fulfill all the dragons' orders, collect the Signs, play your role, and see where that takes you. As soon as they introduce you to the Lords, you ask to do you a favor instead. Death to the League! Haha.
Well, at least some assistance in our fight. Good luck, soldier.

We agree only with the triple alliance. The League and the Empire should put aside their petty war, then we will help you.
There is a beautiful tale about a wonderful planet where everybody has enough space, but its inhabitants strive to live close together. They understood that, together, it's easier to move forward. "Only through sharing others' misfortunes and joy can we truly feel alive. Together, we become one with the planet's essence and soul". Those were their exact words.
But one terrible day that planet shattered into pieces. The inhabitants became as lonely as the planet's drifting shards, swallowed by the Astral plane. The soul of their world has been splintered and they became estranged from each other...
I hope that you understand the meaning of this story and you can help me finish it with a happy ending from the present.
Ask Masters about forming an alliance following an order of Laura de Grandeur.

I have been thinking all this time... It's nice when war brings no casualties - soldiers resurrect and are thrown into battle again. But after the death of thousands, feelings mold into a sense of meaninglessness. A week later, soldiers make jokes with the enemy and drink together.
Oh, Tensess, do I really grumble about your divine gift? Do I really want people to die again forever? It's time to wake up!
We need to establish an alliance with Masters. As far as I know, you have the best opportunity to follow the path of the great Ath-Zak. Seek out the Masters as he once did and discuss nothing but a hopeful and peaceful future.

We agree only the triple alliance. The League and the Empire should put aside their petty war, then we will help you.
There is a beautiful tale about a wonderful planet where everybody has enough space, but its inhabitants strive to live close together. They understood that, together, it's easier to move forward. "Only through sharing others' misfortunes and joy can we truly feel alive. Together, we become one with the planet's essence and soul". Those were their exact words.
But one terrible day that planet shattered into pieces. The inhabitants became as lonely as the planet's drifting shards, swallowed by the Astral plane. The soul of their world has been splintered and they became estranged from each other...
I hope that you understand the meaning of this story and you can help me finish it with a happy ending from the present.
Activate the ruin and pass the test, then talk to the Spirit of Doubt by the next ruins.

Close your eyes and cleanse your mind. Forget the League and the Empire, Tensess and Nezeb, Ath-Zak and Tka-Rik...
There is only you and the world, which must be accepted in order to change it forever. Get ready...
Place your hand on this ruin and pass your test.

Did you pass the test?
Remember that the Path is not only testing your strength or courage, but an ability to see the Truth and make the right conclusions.

Do you see? Do you see now? Astral monsters did not flinch outside their native Astral plane. They are no longer afraid of iron. They are becoming more clever... Learning to hide, wait, and gather strength.
What if during the Great Astral Campaign we were attacked by demons of this new breed? Would we have survived? What if such an onslaught happened tomorrow?
Why have they changed? Evolution? Or some alien plan out of our understanding? Who is teaching these demons ways of bring destruction to Sarnaut?
Think about all this on your way to the next ruin. There you will pass another test.
Activate ruin, pass the test, then talk to the Spirit of Sorrow by the next ruins.

Get ready for the next test, Chosen One. Be prepared before hand, do not relax.
School teaches you lots of things and you are used to having lots of time before confronted with the day's lesson. And when that bell rings, the test will end and you will be free.
But real tests will never give you chance to gather your thoughts. You have got to be on your toes and ready to act on instinct anytime regardless of the circumstances.
You know the drill. Touch the ruin and meet another horror foreign to this world.
Is the test passed? Do you know exactly what's going to happen? Well, of course not. That's the point of the test!

Do you understand what's taking place, Chosen one? There are more and more enemies. When you cut off one head, more of them appear its place!
Why is this world being led into an abyss of destruction with each passing day? What governing power desires such sins to plague the lives of relatives, friends, enemies, to all of Sarnaut?
It's sick there is a strong desire of death to those who breathing and to those who haven't gotten a chance to peer into the eyes of their creator.
Who is ruling these demons? Or should I ask, what is ruling these demons? Move onward in search of answers.
Activate the ancient ruin and pass the test, then meet the Spirit of Terror in the cave.

This is the third lesson about the unknown danger threatening Sarnaut. What is the use of powerful weapons and drawing one's blade if you don't know even know who the enemy is. There is no greater weapon that is more effective and destructive than Truth.
Touch and connect with the ruin, Chosen One. After you defeat whatever spawns, look into yourself and try to feel triumph and happiness for the most important victory ahead...
Have you defeated the dangerous unknown?

Victory! That demon mage apparently was the last ancient monster of its kind left behind from the Great Astral Campaign that warriors failed to defeat. The Astral Gateway is sealed for now... But demons will continue to penetrate into our world, destroying it particle by particle. These evil forces are pulsing all around us, more so than in the past. Unfortunately, Nezeb, Skrakan, and hundreds of great warriors gave their lives protecting Sarnaut from Astral destruction.
Do you feel your triumph, Chosen One? Does the taste of victory tickles your nerves and bring heat to cheeks? Do you feel happiness and release over your great feats?
The Great Astral Campaign... A great lie, a great mistake... Was the great June Tka-Rik who was sent to a useless death the only one who could defend this world?
Connect with the last June ruin, defeat the Curse, and talk to the Spirit of Terror.

Welcome, Chosen One. Waiting for you is the final straightaway of your Path.
Feel desperation and fear of the last tribe fighting against the great evil that destroyed its people.
Teleport to the moment when Gipat was whole and without conflict. Imagine that your skin is streaked with bronze, your once great tribe is reduced to ashes, and the last Great Mage of your people is standing behind you. In front of you is the June Curse. Your name is Ath-Zak and it is a cold October in the year 786 of a new era...
All the tests we have put you through have allowed you to absorb so much knowledge. We hope you have taken our words in open ears and an open mind.

Oh, no! Instead of the phantom curse...demons? They are here and have already started to gather their forces!. They bypassed our defense system so fast...
No! It can't be! Millions and millions of Chosen Ones will have their Paths blocked. Oh, Prisoner, how insistently you are trying to break our Play! I knew, I felt something evil...
Damn! Probably, they are already on backstage. Lords will be cut down one at a time... Hurry, we must obstruct the demon forces!
Activate the portal, walk along the ghostly bridge to the Astral coast, and meet Spirit of Benevolence.

Take this portal stone and activate it when you are in gates.
Don't be afraid and don't look down. Just run to the light beacons and try not to stumble. Another spirit guide will be waiting for you on the Astral coast.
If demons manage to block the entrance to the dungeon, then you and other Chosen Ones will be cut from Lords, and your Path will come to an end.
Our world will be doomed! Please hurry now...

Demons started to appear from the Astral!
We need to act quickly!
Go down to Dusky Cavern and talk to Lord Zullo.

You must descend into the Defiled Ruins! Find Lord Zullo and follow all of his commands.
The Performance is under threat of annihilation! Demons will do everything in their power to strip you from achieving Revelation! Your future... The fate of everyone lies in your hands.
You can make a world of difference. I believe in you... When you are ready, enter the labyrinth and prepare to face Astral hell!

Quiet... calm down... Unpleasant mental connection... weird... at first... then becomes better... more comfortable... do not fight it...
Don't worry... I already know what you want to tell me...
I need time... to connect to your mind... patience... we'll discuss everything soon... wait...

Danger is now at the footsteps of the caves of Gipat. Look how many there are!
Right now we only have scouts to deal with although If we don't stop them as a whole, eaters and stranglers will make their way here. We must stop the invasion!
Our shield that protects the entrance is supported by power of the Astral plane. However, the forces of Lords has its limits. The only positive thing is that we can use power of our foes against them.
Your task is to fight with demons scouts and collect Astral ashes and dust pieces from their bodies. With the help of these magic essences, we can maintain the shield in working condition.
We all must stand together in this struggle for survival!

Thank you.
Now enter the cave. The Lords need your help!

I must say you have redeemed yourself and my confidence in you is high as it was when we first met.
I have to admit maintenance of ghostly entities is a troublesome task. I've asked your help before with ghost busting. Now I ask for your assistance again.
Keeping track of ogres proved to be the most difficult. A curious observation - we thought we would have problems with bandits and villagers, but we were dead wrong...
Spectral ogres became rebellious! They don't adhere to their designated routes and we've received reports of their random outbursts of action aggression from wandering locals who tread too close to their comfort zone. We want to know the reason for their rage.
I beg you to help. We need to obtain some important artifacts, which allow us to understand why cannibals have gone mad. I'm speaking about ghost essence and ashes. You can find them fighting against ogres located around the Cursed Path.
You're more familiar with the seamy side of the Performance. I'm not just here to lead individuals on the Path, but I also bear a responsibility for everything that happens here.

Thank you.
Having examined these samples we will be able to understand the nature of the problems.
Find scientist Sarbaz Takhat somewhere along the path.

As you know we are researching Gipat and all of its glorious mysteries. We need to find out a lot in order to understand this allods' history. We have even asked detached specialists.
I'm speaking about ZIT scientist Sarbaz Takhat. He wanted to help us to understand the nature of ghosts living on Gipat. It's been weeks and we still don't have news of his whereabouts or findings.
He went along the road past Misty Shore. Please help us find him!

Historians sent you here, did they?
Are they more worried about my well being or the knowledge I possess? They want to know everything as soon as possible?
I see. That's the fate of all who don't have ages to wait.
Find scientist Sarbaz Takhat somewhere along the path.

As you know we are researching Gipat and all of its glorious mysteries. We need to find out a lot in order to understand this allods' history. We have even asked detached specialists.
I'm speaking about ZIT scientist Sarbaz Takhat. He wanted to help us to understand the nature of ghosts living on Gipat. It's been weeks and we still don't have news of his whereabouts or findings.
He went along the road past Misty Shore. Please help us find him!

Historians sent you here, did they?
Are they more worried about my well being or the knowledge I possess? They want to know everything as soon as possible? I see. That's the fate of all who don't have ages to wait.
Search under the fallen blocks for something valuable.

Ancient treasures can be found in Junes ruins!
So we should examine this place with scrutiny.

Here it is - Treasure of Gipat!
And no need to share the fourth part of it.
Examine June ruins southwest of the Cursed Path to find treasure of Gipat. Report back to Touchy Family once you have found it.

Do you know the story of this famous Ath-Zak?
Ah! So do we. He seems to be very famous. And hero means treasure!
We have already examined this wasteland but failed to find anything valuable. Pity, huh?
Maybe you will be more lucky? June ruins are home to great history and mystery. If we wanted to hide treasure, we would do so around ruins.
Have you ever been southwest the Cursed Path? There are isolated ruins there. Seek out ancient treasure!

We could of spent more time searching for lost treasure, but these little dragons...
They have been watching us very intently!

Ah, what a pity! Pity that it was not us who found the treasure!
So be it! Surely this is not the last treasure in Gipat! We will find our own treasure! No doubt about it!
Collect 14 Signs of the Chosen for permission to continue with the Path.

Naughty creature! Why have you become distracted into useless rebellion with goblins and follow rebels' orders?
Your unjustified acts show that you are not ready to continue on the Path. I will set a price for your mistakes. You must bring me fourteen Signs of the Chosen now!
You will repeat Ath-Zak's steps one by one each day until you understand what it means to be the Chosen One.
Thank you for enduring my punishment. I now give you permission to move forward.
Travel to Gipat and speak to the Spirit of Peace about the Astral Confrontation.

A new letter from Director instructs you to travel to Gipat and talk to the Spirit of Peace.
It might be worth listening to this Spirit.
I hope I can answer all your questions.

Now you know everything you need.
Good luck!
Scatter the Handful of Astral Dust, defeat the Wretched Demon Mage, and report to Anastasia Yahontova.

Let me introduce myself - Anastasia Yahontova. On Clement's Isle I helped all the newcomers to get support in this life, prepare for oncoming trials. That's what I want to do now.
To begin with - a bit of history.
When Astral wave covered Sarnaut and started eating the world, Great Mages were the only ones who could resist Cataclysm. But Power and Knowledge must be paid! Twelve brave men gave their lives to protect this world. This was in vain! They are still with us, giving patronage, they are ready to give part of their power to those who wants their help.
That's what I want to offer you. We can hold the initiation ritual right here.
Take it. This is Astral dust piece. Go eastwards to the June stele on the coast. Scatter it there. And... accept the power and get the Martyr.
Wait, one more thing!
Appealing to the power of Twelve Great Martyrs, you will have to unwillingly disturb Astral. Astral demon will appear. Your target is to defeat him. I'm sure you'll succeed.
Only after victory over Astral demon symbolizing the victory of Great Mages over Astral the ritual can be considered finished.

So the ritual is finished!
From now on the power of your Martyr will be with you. You can use Martyr's Salvation ability to restore your strength after combat using drops of mirra that I give you. When you spend all of them, you will be able to buy more from Servants of Light.
Who knows, maybe you will have the honor to get the higher ranks of Patronage and your power will increase.
Participate in Witch's Hollow and Deserted Farm battlegrounds, then report to Roughneck Family in Novograd.

Not only battlegrounds represent a great opportunity to prove that you are capable fighter - this is also a great way to obtain useful equipment. I can tell you more.

At the Witch's Hollow battleground your team must capture and hold key locations marked on the map. The more locations you control, the more points per second you are assigned. The first team to get 2500 points is the winner.

At the Deserted Farm the goal of your team is also to collect 2500 points, but there is only one key location in the middle of the battleground. June Bombards found by the team camps will help you to capture it.

All participants receive the reward according to their contribution. Pieces of Battleground Emblems are combined into the complete emblems that can be used to purchase equipment from Soldiers of Fortune's Quartermasters.
We've seen bloody battles in our time...
Good job! Remember, you need to improve your reputation towards the Soldiers of Fortune by participating in battlegrounds and collecting Battleground Emblems.
Go to the Astral shore and activate the Mysterious Meteorite Stone. Then return to Selene de Ardeur.

You know, I'm really worried about Amanda. You should have seen how her face twisted up in terror when she saw where we ended up. Heehee!
Hm, but never mind me. I really don't mean to be mean, you see. Whoa! Did you see what I did there? Anyway, I'm willing to help Amanda through this emotional crisis.
I'm an Elf, aren't I? That means I know a thing or two about magic and you'd need to be a complete fool to not realize that the stones Amanda gave us had weird magical properties.
Thinking back to your escapade in Clement's Tower, it's safe to assume that you're no stranger to danger. So... I was hoping you could help me out with a little experiment.
Here's what I want you to do - try and activate the stone. Whoa, hold your horses - I didn't mean here! You should do it somewhere else... you know, for safety reasons. I'd suggest a deserted part of the beach. Go ahead, let's see what happens!
I hope everything will be all right, and that we finally solve the secret of this stone!

Whoa, it's you!
Is that the stone's doing? Jeepers!
Report on the results of the experiment to Amanda de Desirae.

What are you saying...

This mysterious stone can teleport you... where? To the nearest portal apparently... Amazing!

My cousin Marianne de Ardeur, the abbess of the Church of Light, reproached me often for neglecting magical disciplines. I wish she could see me now, solving the mystery of this strange stone!

Go see Amanda. She went deep into the island with her men. I hear they set up camp there. Find her and tell her everything. Tell her it's not her fault we ended up here. It's all because of this stone! I think...

But wait before going there - listen to what they have to say in our camp first. And gain a patron.

Is that so? Selena believes that everything is connected to this small stone?
Maybe... But I should've figured it all out myself! How could I lose sight of those stones! Could it be that I misunderstood Uncle's notes?
Listen, I need some time to think about all this.
Meet with Anastasia Yahontova on Evermeet Isle.

I want to give you a little advice. One of the survivors is a wise Kanian druid named Anastasia Yahontova. She used to help some of the new recruits gain their patronage on Clement's Tower.
If you gain this patronage you'll become much stronger! It can help you defeat powerful enemies that you would normally be unable to conquer. Please, go talk to her. She's over by the fire.
I'm so glad you're okay! It was quite brave of you to fight an Astral demon without any patronage! Few people can manage to do that.
Find an ancient June stele along the northwestern shore, collect 3 ancient stones, and bring them to Amanda de Desirae.

Let's get back on this subject together. Here's what I've come up with.
The portal that brought us to this allod is the handiwork of the ancient June civilization. Just like these strange stones. Perhaps this is the answer. Could we be dealing with some ancient June magic that somehow connects these stones with the June portals? Could this be what brought us to this allod and not Novograd?
In order to verify this theory, I gathered some more stones. Now I need June items that still hold traces of magic.
Scouts report seeing a June ruin along the northwestern coast. The June used such steles to conduct their rituals. Please find these ruins and bring me back a few stones - obsidian are best.
Oh, I just can't wait!
Were you able to find the ruins?
You found the stones? Excellent! Give them to me so I can examine them.
Explore the shore to the southeast in search of Astral Crystals. Charge the Meteorite Stone and bring it to Amanda de Desirae in the Scout Camp.

Yes, I can feel ancient traces of magic in these Stones! But they are very, very weak. I can't quite understand how they work.
Maybe if we increase the power of this magic, we'll be able to identify what it does. I know, we can use the Astral! Astral is pure magic itself, but it's very powerful and dangerous. Only Great Mages have been able to control it, and even then they can't solve all of its riddles.
Oh, don't worry, I'm not going to try something dangerous. That failed attempt with the resistance sphere in Clement's Tower was enough for me. But that doesn't mean that we should give up!
Sometimes Astral crystals grow along the shore that contain a small amount of Astral power. Uncle warned me that they can be dangerous to young mages... But I'm no young mage!
We need to find one of these crystals and try to awaken the power of those Stones. Go explore the southern shore and bring me back a crystal!

Lok has explored the southeastern shore already, but he didn't say anything about Astral crystals. But then again, I didn't ask him to look for them. But you're probably more attentive than he is anyway.

Yes! The powers of the Stone have been awakened. I can feel it!
Now I just need to figure out exactly how it works... It should just take a few experiments I'm sure! Just... stay here with me, okay? I feel more confident with you around.
Find the mysterious benefactor and ask for his help.

I'm afraid I just can't do it! What if something goes terribly wrong... again! I mean, I'm not a Great Mage yet!
Bah! I am an Elf, and we Elves never quit! That is the motto of not only the House de Desirae, but of Elves everywhere! If I can't figure out how these Stones work, but there are many lives at stake here and we must do something.
I know, what about our mysterious benefactor? If he's powerful enough to send us these supplies without our knowledge, then he's sure to possess great magical talent! Maybe he's even a Great Mage himself! He's got to be on this allod somewhere. Search every corner of it and ask him to help us get home!
Who are you? I don't like my solitude to be disturbed. But then again, that's already happened I suppose. These bandits are all over the place.
Wait until the end of The Nameless One's ritual.

Let me see this mysterious stone. Now I will try to awaken the ancient magic of this artifact. When you're speaking about June magic you should always remember that it's a very strange and nearly forgotten practice. Amanda didn't know how it worked. In fact, most people don't know how it works. I'm only just beginning to understand it myself.

If I'm not mistaken, this artifact was used to tap into ancient teleportation trails.

They were used by the ancient June people to travel between different locations. This technology was one of the highlights of their civilization, and the activators were built so well that they are some of the only June structures that stand today. Roughly translated, they called these things "Adventurer's Stones".

You should be able to activate it whenever you're near some ancient June ruins to travel to other nearby ruins. After a quick ritual it should be as good as new.
Didn't I tell you to be patient?

It's done. Go ahead and take your mysterious stone back. Well, I guess it's not so "mysterious" anymore, is it? I believe that I've solved all of its mysteries. Make sure to hold on to it tightly - it's quite a treasure.
Speak with the Portal Keeper in Novograd and bind your Adventurer's Stone's essence to their portal.

This "Adventurer's Stone" of yours is a strange thing indeed! The Nameless One must have awoken some sort of ancient June magic in it. We must take it to the Elven emissary in Novograd - I'm sure our Elves will be able to create similar stones.
Think about it, each League citizen having their own stone and traveling through the Astral! Life will be so much easier!
You should remember that every time you discover a new June ruin you can bind your Stone's essence to that specific ruin. There are also highly skilled Portal Keepers that will bind your Stone's essence to their portal. Then you can activate your Stone to instantly return to those locations.
Greetings! What do you want to talk about?

I've already heard about this new discovery! An ancient June artifact serving the League! Just the thought sends chills down my spine! Do you want to bind it's essence to this portal? I can help you with that!
Bring 4 pieces of venison to the Bugeyed Family's camp in the birch grove.

Hey, want to help us out with something?

We all need to eat, right? We also have these crabs here, and gifts from a mysterious benefactor. But the scouts who went with Amanda are probably in trouble... There's a herd of deer not far from our camp, to the north from here. What do you say?

Can you get us four pieces of venison? After all, life is more fun on a full stomach, and the problems don't seem as daunting.
I'm in the mood for some fried venison. We know the best way to cook it! And there's the deer, you can see them from here. But I can't leave my post...
Thank you, I didn't expect that! The future doesn't look so bleak now.
Search the Bearded Crabs for anything useful and report to the Dumpling Family.

Hello! Remember us? We're really grateful for your help! We were there... when demons attacked. Ah, we really hoped we'd be teleported to Novograd!

But we wound up here, on this desert island... Though Amanda believes there has to be someone controlling this allod. Unless there's no meteorite ore here.

Well, it's not like we can do anything about it...

Have you seen the local crabs? Those speedy little bastards are running all over the shore!

We've noticed that they're not your regular crabs. We saw something similar on Umoir. It's all because of the Astral!

An elf once told me that certain creatures can develop magical abilities because of it! What did he say... Give a moment... Right! "Long-term exposure to the astral substance leads to irreversible changes in their bodies." There you go!

We wonder if their mutations could be useful to us? We should find out! On Umoir, we extracted astral blobs from them. Maybe we can do that here?

We want you to hunt those crabs for us. If you find an astral blob, try and figure out how it works!
That Astral is so mysterious! You never know what to expect!

So, what did you find? ...Hmm, that thing clearly had magical properties, but I'm afraid it doesn't have much practical use for us.
Well, we're glad that at least you benefitted from it! And let this be a lesson to you - there are lots of wondrous things in the world! You never know what you may stumble across and how useful it might be, so always remember to keep an eye out!
Kill 3 Forest Adders and report to Alice de Doucer.

Out of the frying pan and into the fire! We leave the Great Mage's tower and find ourselves in this dump! No shower, no nothing...
And the snakes around here! I took a couple of steps into the birch grove and this nasty adder was all over me. I just barely escaped with my life! I mean, crazy, right?
Hm, I remember your face... Ah, I got it - I've seen you in the portal battle! Great! You're the one I need!
Go into the grove and kill every adder in sight. Since we're probably stuck here, we might as well try and turn this creepy place into something enjoyable and safe. So, I'll take care of all the hard management work and you... you just get in there and hit stuff.
If you need something, just let me know. I am a Servant of the Light! I can always provide you with drops of mirra. Remember, the Church is there to help those in need!
I saw another snake just now! They're disgusting!

So, it's ten adders that you've killed? Not enough! I've got to think up some kind of poison to get rid of them once and for all.
In the meantime I think I'll stay here and look at the June ruins. They're the stones right there on the shore. They're the remains of a lost civilization, you know.
Such ruins always seem to attract bounty hunters. Barbarians! They hope to find something valuable and don't realize the ruins are valuable all by themselves. They are so beautiful!...
Gather 3 Dog Rose Berries and take them to Nikolai Rubtsov in the Scout Camp.

Nikolai Rubtsov, my... well, a good friend of mine, went inland on a scouting mission. They hope to find some way of leaving this place. I'm sure they can do it - my Slavuta is with them!
I'd like to support my friend. I saw some dog rose bushes in the forest and that's his favorite berry! Do me a favor and gather some to take to him as a present from me. My mother used to say that showing attention to your loved ones can be a great help in times of trouble.
Please beware of adders! Try not to disturb them while gathering the berries.
Do you have any news from Daria? I miss her so much.
Dog Rose Berries? For me? Well, it's very nice of you, and so touching. Though I'd have preferred... Never mind, many thanks.
Take the Mysterious Box of Supplies to Amanda de Desirae.

That melancholy Elf over there took a stroll along the shore and found this strange box. Of course, we've already opened it - inside there were weapons, food, medicine, and clothes - all you need to live on a deserted allod! It's an answer to our prayers, like someone knew just what we needed!
We've got to send some of these to our scouts and tell them about the find. We have a feeling this allod isn't so deserted after all. The scouts went north along the path through the birch grove. Get on up to their camp as fast as you can!
Yay! There you finally are! I kept my fingers crossed for your safe return. Things are definitely going to get better with you around! So, what news do you have for me?
Wow! We can really make use of all of these! I wonder who it's from. Well, I guess we shouldn't worry about that for now. Meanwhile, choose whatever you want from this box.
Talk to Charles de Vevre, who can introduce you to the talents of a bard.

Hear ye! Hear ye!
Can you hold a weapon? Do you believe in freedom, equality, and brotherhood? Then our trainers of Novograd are here to set you on the path to victory!
The most experienced and wisest teachers are prepared to share their knowledge.
What are your interests? Do you sing well? Can you play? Good enough! A good singer-musician has great prospects!
If you'd like to learn some new songs, meet with Charles de Vevre in Novograd's Elven District. They say he's got a voice of gold!
Hey there! I can see that you, too, have been blessed by a visit from the muses! Great! There's nothing better than a good song! Well, except for throngs of attentive listeners.

Let me just check my list... Ah, Timur Siniakov! He will be your trainer. Don't just stand around, you need to go make yourself useful to the League!

You want to be a warden?
You're sure that you want to learn our ancient magic?
